profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hello! I'm Christian Reyes, a recent graduate of Vanderbilt University with a degree in computer science. I'm driven by a passion for learning and a commitment to bridging the achievement gap. As a first-generation student, I overcame obstacles to earn full-ride scholarships to both a private boarding school and Vanderbilt University.

My interest in computer science was sparked by my participation in All-Star Code, an educational program focused on creating economic opportunities for young men of color. Since then, I’ve expanded my technical skills through programs like the Google Computer Science Summer Institute (CSSI), SEO Tech Developer and Netflix x Formation, equipping me with skills and knowledge in Python, C++, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, APIs, databases, and data structures.

Currently, I’m building on these foundations as a software engineer at S&P Global, where I’m gaining valuable experience in software development, cloud computing, DevOps, and automation while contributing to impactful projects. I’m always open to connecting—feel free to reach out if you’d like to learn more about my skills and experiences.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Gained valuable insights into cloud computing principles and best practices, laying a strong foundation in AWS technologies
- Utilized Python, Ansible, and Terraform to design and implement cloud-based software solutions and automate infrastructure management

positions.title: SEO Tech Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Engaged in a highly specialized technical development and mentorship program to advance in the tech industry
- Created and presented various group and individual projects using Python, HTML, CSS, APIs, and Databases
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Databases · Python (Programming Language) · SQL · GitHub · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · HTML

positions.title: Student at Google's Computer Science Summer Institute (CSSI)
positions.description:
- Participated in a 4-week intensive computer science summer program for high-achieving students
- Completed an introductory project-based JavaScript processing curriculum taught by Google engineers
- Attended product design, resume development, and software engineering interview workshops
- Delivered a collaborative final project presentation that included a live demonstration to Google
employees and community leaders

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Developed an understanding of basic computer engineering and computer science ideas at an enrichment program at local engineering company
- Spearheaded a team of two individuals to construct the AGI International Space Station (ISS) Locator

AGI International Space Station (ISS) Locator (C++)
- Constructed a dynamic mapping software that plotted the current location of the ISS on a 3D model of the Earth
- Indexed and analyzed longitude and latitude data using C++ and the “Where the ISS at?” API
- Assembled mapping mechanism using Arduino tool kit and software

positions.title: Student
positions.description:
- Attended a 6-week coding bootcamp focused on motivated Black and Latino young men
- Learned fundamental programming concepts and built web pages using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
- Utilized the p5.js library to develop interactive visual programs and browser games
- Introduced to soft skills and observed the tech culture through an engaging experience inside educational and corporate spaces
- Gained insight from industry experts on career planning and development
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · GitHub · JavaScript · HTML
